# Capability matrix

This page is generated. I wrote a test that builds every preset's adapter, reads what it reports and the compat flags the preset names, counts the rows of its catalog file, and writes the table below. The same test fails when this file is not what it would write, so the matrix cannot drift from the code. To refresh it after changing a preset, an adapter or the catalog, run `AIBUS_WRITE_CAPABILITIES=1 cargo test -p aibus-testkit --test capability_matrix` (in a container) and commit the diff.

The capability columns are the provider's default for a model its table says nothing about; a catalog row can override any of them for one model (`docs/PROVIDERS.md`, "What a model can do"). `Auth` lists the `auth` forms the preset accepts. `Model list` is whether the adapter can ask the server for its models, and `Count tokens` whether it can count before a request (otherwise the estimate is used).

| Preset | API | Auth | Tools | Parallel tools | Thinking | Effort | Images | Prompt cache | Logprobs | Model list | Count tokens | Catalog rows | Compat flags |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `alpha` | openai-chat | keyring, env, file | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | no | no | yes | no | 3 | max_tokens_field=max_completion_tokens, no_store |
| `beta` | anthropic-vertex | gcloud | yes | yes | no | no | no | no | no | no | no | 0 | none |
